'''Yagnaswami Sundara Rajan''' or '''Y. S. Rajan''' (born 10 April 1943) is an Indian professor, scientist and administrator. He is Honorary Distinguished Professor in [[Indian Space Research Organisation]]. He has made major contributions to various aspects of management of science, technology and innovation. In 2012, he was awarded with [[Padma Shri]] for his contributions in science and engineering.<ref>{{cite web|url= http://www.pib.nic.in/newsite/erelease.aspx?relid=79881|title= Padma Awards Announced|publisher=[[Press Information Bureau]], Ministry of Home Affairs|date= 25 January 2012 |access-date= 29 July 2015 }}</ref> He is one of the well known scientists who has closely worked with [[Abdul Kalam]], former [[President of India]].<ref>{{cite news|title=A Friend Remembers Kalam: He belonged more at ISRO than DRDO |url=https://indianexpress.com/article/india/india-others/a-friend-remembers-kalam-he-belonged-more-at-isro-than-drdo/|date=29 July 2015|first=Amitabh|last=Sinha|access-date=31 January 2019|newspaper=[[The Indian Express]]}}</ref>

==Early life==
Y. S. Rajan was born into a [[Tamil Brahmin]]<ref>{{Cite book |last=Rajan |first=Y. S. |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=QtotCwAAQBAJ&q=y+s+rajan+brahman&pg=PT45 |title=Way Beyond The Three Rs: India's Educational Challenge in the 21st Century |date=2010-12-08 |publisher=Penguin UK |isbn=978-93-5214-183-8 |pages=45 |language=en}}</ref> family on 10 April 1943 in [[Kottaram]] near [[Tirunelveli]]. His grandfather, Sundara Ganapadigal was a great Vedic scholar. His mother's name is Visalakshi and father's name is S Yagnaswami. His parents moved to [[Mumbai]], and Dr. Y S Rajan went on to do his schooling and later college education here. He received his master's degree in Physics from the [[University of Bombay]] in 1964. He started his career as a research scholar at Physical Research Laboratory.

==Career==
He went on to hold several positions including scientific secretary positions in [[Department of Space]], [[Indian Space Research Organisation]]. He contributed in areas like STI administration, institution building, diplomacy, strategic studies, environmental technologies, and natural resources management. He was elected as Member of [[International Academy of Astronautics]] (IAA) (1986). He was the first Executive Director of Technology Information and Forecasting and Assessment Council (TIFAC), since (1988-2002) and executed Mission REACH, an initiative of TIFAC.  He has held several senior positions in [[National Natural Resources Management System]], [[Confederation of Indian Industry]].<ref>{{cite web|title=ADVISORY BOARD|url=http://www.aserf.org.in/directors/ys_rajan.html|website=aserf.org|publisher=Apeejay Stya Education Research Foundation}}</ref> He also served as Vice-Chancellor in [[Punjab Technical University]] (PTU), Scientific Adviser to Punjab Chief Minister, Chairman of the Board in [[Nalanda University]]<ref>{{cite news|title=Kalam to attend first board meeting of Nalanda university|url=http://www.bihartimes.in/newsbihar/2008/jan/newsbihar30jan2.html|access-date=29 July 2015|agency=BiharTimes}}</ref> and adjunct professor in [[Birla Institute of Technology & Science]] (BITS), Pilani.

==Books and works==
He is a co-author of ''[[India 2020]]: A Vision for the New Millennium'' with [[A P J Abdul Kalam]].<ref>{{cite book|last1=Kalam|first1=A.P.J. Abdul|last2=Y.S.|first2=Rajan|title=India 2020: A Vision for the New Millennium|publisher=New York|year=1998|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=pCN7NwAACAAJ&q=vision+2020+abdul+kalam|isbn=978-0-670-88271-7}}</ref> (Hindi version: ''Bharat 2020 Aur Uske Baad''). He has authored many books including ''Discover Your Power Quotient'' and more than 200 articles and papers, which have also been published in international journals.

==Honours==
He has been honored with many awards including [[Padma Shri]] (2012), Fellow of the Indian National Academy of Engineering (1998), Fellow of World Academy of Art and Science (WAAS) (2010), Honorary Degree of Doctor of Letters (D.Litt.) from Jain Vishva Bharati University, Ladnun, Rajasthan (2005)<ref>{{cite web|url= http://www.ysrajan.com/index.php/articles/252-yagnaswami-sundara-rajan|title= YS Rajan Profile|access-date= 26 August 2013 }}</ref>
